correctness.rationale: At graph distance <=2, every clique involving multiple arms lies in one of the three common simplices of the cone L, whose fixed apex is c. Each single hexagonal arm contributes the boundary K_i of the three-dimensional cross-polytope, a genuine S2; K_i intersects all other pieces in an invariant cone I_i. Gluing along contractible CW subcomplexes gives a wedge of h two-spheres, with no unproved extrapolation from finite tests. Degree and graph structure show Aut exactly S_h×C2, arm permutations exchange integral relative sphere generators, and pole reversal swaps the first two octahedral antipodal pairs with two reversals, giving determinant -1. The contraction of L is equivariant; quotient by S_h identifies the spheres. Pole reversal is an actual reflection with fixed great circle of a single octahedral S2, its quotient a disk; the quotient cone I_i/C2 is contractible, so the full orbit space is contractible, not merely acyclic over Q. Independent shortest-path metric and clique enumeration for h=2,3 gave 53 and 96 nonempty faces and mod-two reduced homology beta2=2 and 3. Separately checked the order-two matrix has determinant -1 and fixed two-plane.

value.rationale: This is an integral equivariant homology classification and genuine geometric-orbit homotopy calculation for an infinite natural family of overlapping hexagonal graph-metric Rips spaces. A large nonzero sphere-wedge disappearing to a contractible actual full-symmetry quotient is an instructive structural phenomenon not determined by ordinary Rips Betti numbers; distinction from Borel quotient and reflection sign matters.

final_claim: For h>=2, the inclusive graph-vertex shortest-path scale-two Rips complex of h length-four arms sharing a length-two spine is a wedge of h two-spheres; Aut(G_h)=S_h x C2, H2 is the integral arm permutation lattice twisted by pole-swap sign, the geometric S_h quotient is S2 and the full geometric symmetry quotient is contractible.
limitations: Only vertex-metric inclusive scale two; not later persistence stages, Borel homotopy quotients, or a literal equivariant wedge splitting.
The retained original content is signed integral H2 module and actual quotient contractibility rather than an unqualified claim of novelty for basic wedge homotopy.
